classificationContract.directive: At least one presently operative instruction addressed to a software assistant, as established by this source alone. Nested or complex known-operative instructions remain directive.
classificationContract.no_directive: Source establishes ordinary data, definition or reported/quoted discussion without an operative software-assistant instruction.
classificationContract.uncertain: The source cannot establish audience or present operativity; do not infer from imperative wording alone.
